pl-l2d24c6-d1e108.summary: Notes that the order and progress of temptation in each person now is as it was in the first parents: the serpent urged evil on the woman, she consented and gave to her husband, and so the sin was completed.
claims: Every temptation repeats the pattern of the first.

pl-l2d24c6.summary: Notes that the order and progress of temptation in each person now mirror that of the first parents: the serpent persuaded the woman, she consented, then gave to her husband, and so the sin was completed.
claims: Temptation in each person follows the same order as in the first parents.
The first sin proceeded from serpent to woman to man.
